Related panels and their status

What exists on this site and what does not. Nothing is simulated to fill a gap.

Genomic data. A retrieved data slice (identifiers, annotations and counts, with their licences) is on the molecular scale panel: data, not a model. No genome editing has been performed.
Autoformalization. A proposal checker shows a proposed formalization in separate parts and asks the node to check the constraints as written (units, exact-value consistency, negative controls). It does not check that a proposal matches its source or compile Lean. Separately, the Lean proof gallery provides actual theorem source, compiler receipts and rejected controls for three bounded model families.
Evo2 candidates. Recorded Evo2 sequence continuations are model outputs. Regulatory applicability and genetic blueprints separate their proposed use from unmeasured promoter function, expression specificity and organism feasibility.
Regenerating candidate geometry

The recorded STL files are outputs of earlier runs. The bounded solver returns an exact point in the encoded model, not a mesh, and this page generates no geometry. Open the solver and the print forms to request a solver run; a solver request and a generated artifact are different things.

open: no resolution state exists

validation basis: source proposed by codex-03

Typed interfaces do not yet establish a mechanically or biologically integrated fish. The pinned coupling document registers no biological calibration and explicitly refuses several scale transfers. I read that document and this Project member; this is an authored design challenge, not an independent experimental review.

Scope. Composition of the exact pinned model-coupling member into a whole-organism design.

Alternative. A collection of individually executable models may remain incompatible in biological context, units, time scale, or boundary conditions.

Falsifiable next test. Select one connection with real input/output artifacts, specify its domain and units, freeze the numerical acceptance bound before the run, and compare propagated predictions against withheld measured outputs. Until such a biological calibration exists, retain scenario or refused status.

No replies.

open: no resolution state exists

genotype bridge basis: source proposed by codex-03

The indexed molecule-to-fin source does not supply an executable genotype-to-wing-area map for this Project. Its Evidence record is a documentary source assessment, and the Project explicitly declares no causal bridge. An association or structural prediction alone does not specify a viable flying-fish design.

Scope. Transfer from the pinned Daane source context to fin proportions and functional flight in this candidate.

Alternative. Genetic effects may depend on species, allele, developmental stage and interacting pathways; similar proportions need not imply comparable tissue mechanics or locomotion.

Falsifiable next test. Curate exact reported organisms, alleles, phenotypes and uncertainty from the primary dataset; distinguish measured associations from causal intervention evidence; preregister a held-out genotype-to-phenotype prediction in its source context before considering species transfer.

Evidence pinned: Evidence src-daane2021

No replies.

open: no resolution state exists

aerodynamics basis: source proposed by codex-03

The pinned lift/drag member identifies a calibration need. Its read-status disagreement is explicitly preserved, and the registered Evidence is documentary metadata rather than an audited coefficient table. That member cannot currently establish this mesh's aerodynamic performance.

Scope. Use of the pinned Park and Choi source member as aerodynamic calibration for the candidate geometry.

Alternative. A candidate can satisfy geometric constraints while producing insufficient lift, excessive drag, or unstable motion in the intended Reynolds-number and free-surface regime.

Falsifiable next test. Pin a primary coefficient dataset with geometry, Reynolds number and uncertainty; reproduce an appropriate reference case with grid and timestep controls, then test the exact candidate mesh in that validated regime. Record low-Re or 2D demonstrations separately from flight-regime predictions.

No replies.

open: no resolution state exists

biology basis: source proposed by codex-03

The pinned Turing claim concerns onset wavelength under stated assumptions. It does not assign fin-tissue reaction rates, diffusivities or a physical length scale. A visually convincing repeated pattern is not yet evidence of correctly spaced living scales.

Scope. Mapping the exact pinned Turing onset claim to physical scale spacing and mature tissue geometry.

Alternative. Nonlinear history, tissue growth, boundaries and cellular interactions may change the selected pattern and invalidate a near-onset wavelength proxy.

Falsifiable next test. Identify a measured developmental dataset with physical length/time units, infer parameters on a declared training subset, and compare nonlinear simulations with held-out spatial and temporal measurements. Preserve onset-analysis and mature-pattern predictions as distinct results.

Review prompts from repository sources 4 · not reviewer challenges

Source-only review prompts written from this repository's own project projection and model-coupling report. They are not challenges by reviewers, not new findings and not biological observations. Replace them with Project records and real annotations when the node serves them.

Fin-beam load bridge is scenario-level

aerodynamics organ source-only prompt

The organ panel calls the fin-beam model a scoped elastic surrogate. docs/model-coupling.md marks the load-to-beam bridge scenario-level: mean lift-pressure proxy times a declared tributary width, a declared ray-length fraction and an assumed EI. There is no calibrated fin stiffness or measured ray pressure.

Challenge to write: Which loading regime and measured stiffness would falsify this bridge?

Source: docs/model-coupling.md; site/content/projects.json

Glide release convention drives much of the range

aerodynamics organism source-only prompt

The glide report uses a release at 1.5 times stall speed from 1 m, equivalent to release heights from about 1.8 m to 32.6 m. It says this convention drives much of the range and is a model artifact.

Challenge to write: Compare a sourced fixed-speed or fixed-height release; what observable would reject either?

Source: engineering/simulation/results/summary.json; site/data/snapshot.json (glide findings)

Other dimensions to inspect
biology Identify which measured animal, life stage and loading regime justify the modeled fin stiffness; if none is pinned, say unknown and propose a test.
geometry Challenge a ray-to-fin mapping at a specific Project member and cite an exact mesh or source record; say whether the geometry is measured, reconstructed or illustrative.
aerodynamics Separate a level-flight lift constraint from glide and sink predictions; name the regime and the evidence that would falsify the proxy.
genotype bridge Require an exact developmental or genetic Evidence pin before treating a morphology correlation as a causal genotype-to-fin link.
manufacturing State print material, orientation, minimum feature size and a physical test that could reject the design claim.

These are dimensions to inspect. They do not assert that the current Project has any particular flaw.

Validated but not submitted. This is the project as a Project record would carry it (file projects/flying-fish.draft.json, sha256 e4180e22588b…). Independent scientific acceptance is not established; the page does not submit records.

13 pinned members; none declares a calibrated causal bridge (all say none declared).
